crossRefs.note: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds…
crossRefs.keyword: chief house. Heb. house of the father. an head

crossRefs.note: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
crossRefs.keyword: chief house. Heb. house of the father. an head

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.
translations.bsb: With him they sent ten chiefs—one family leader from each tribe of Israel, each the head of a family among the clans of Israel.
translations.kjv: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
translations.asv: and with him ten princes, one prince of a fathers' house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were every one of them head of their fathers' houses among the thousands of Israel.
